notes: Page title 'The Beginning'. Branded 'Junktion77' with tagline 'The Foodies' Crossroads' (multicolour diamond logo with fork/spoon icons) top-right, NOT 'Gluttons Garage'. Design: deep maroon/brown background with darker gear/cog pattern; title in pale pink calligraphic display font; item names cream/off-white bold serif, descriptions white condensed sans; prices cream 'NN/-'. Veg/non-veg circular markers: green on most items, red on Chicken Sausages and Chicken Cutlets. Note: 'Grilled Bacon Strips and Scrambled Eggs' and 'English Breakfast combo' carry GREEN markers despite meat/egg content (likely print error) - recorded veg false / null accordingly. Bottom third is food photo (bowl of chocolate cereal 'chocos' on burlap). No tax/service-charge text. Legibility good.
